batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b AG Murtaza

batting.name: UT Yadav
batting.dismissal: st DJ Jacobs b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: AB Dinda
batting.dismissal: c JEC Franklin b SL Malinga

balls.text: no they can't, Malinga gets a five-for, 5-13, third-best figures in IPL history, it's not bowled this time, it's short of a length, slower one, Dinda is much too early into the shot and the gently lobs to mid-off, and Delhi have folded for 95
just short of being a yorker, Dinda defends it back to the bowler, three balls left in the over, can Delhi survive?
a slower full toss outside off, mistimed towards extra cover for a single
van der Merwe unleashes a beautiful drive, a half-volley on legstump, on-driven past Harbhajan at long-on
Harbhajan Singh flights this one, drives it through the off for a single
gets a big stride in and blocks to the off side
gets forward and defends this back to the bowler

turns that one a long way, Umesh Yadav can't cover for the spin, it slides past the pads as he looks to nudge the ball to the leg side, Jacobs collects and have an eternity to remove the bails, Delhi nine down, will they be the first team to be bowled out this season?
watchfully defended off the back foot to the off side
driven down to long-on for a single
a length ball from Malinga, stop the press, it was a slower one too, tentatively defended off the front foot, and Delhi won't mind the time-out
a low full toss on the pads, pushed towards mid-on

oh dear, Morkel's got a new bat but that isn't enough to keep another Maling toe-crusher out, another yorker, another bowled, the richest man in India is quite happy with that, Mukesh Ambani jumps out of his seat to applaud Malinga's fourth
another low full toss on offstump, no footwork from Morkel as he defends that one
Malinga is unstoppable, a swinging low full toss, Venugopal looks to drive that one, but the movement means he can only gets an inside-edge on it, and ball carries on to the base of middle stump
searches for the yorker, it is a low full toss, worked towards wide mid-on
a boundary for Rao, swept hard and in the air, it flies behind square leg for four, Delhe need more of those to make a match of it
muscled towards sweeper cover for a single
length ball on middle and leg, looks to work it to the leg side, mishit to the off side

is he gone for a golden duck? Pathan guides the ball towards short cover and sets off for a single, there was no run in it and he has to turn back, fielder fires in the throw to the keeper, who breaks the stumps, a gazillion replays required to take the decision, I think he is out, and after much deliberation, the giant screen says 'Out', not a great comeback for Irfan
that's the end of the partnership, Murtaza breaks through, Ojha skips beyond leg and launches the ball towards long-off where Malinga accepts the catch
powered down to long-on for a single
short of length ball on off, defended towards the bowler
short of length and outside off, whipped towards midwicket
again the offcutter from Pollard, steered towards backward point
on the pads, worked towards square leg for a single
superbly done by Venugopal Rao, it was an offcutter from Pollard, Venugopal Rao waits for it and opens the face to guide the ball past a diving short third man for four
short of length and on off, defended towards cover and a quick single is taken
whipped towards midwicket, batsmen think of a second but after a lot of screaming decide to settle for a single
missed stumping, fired way down the leg side, Jacobs does well to collect, but can't balance himself and then take off the bails, Ojha was a long way down the track
works this one towards fine leg for a single
dropped, Ojha skips down the track and away from the stumps, and muscles the  ball to the left of the bowler, who tries to latch on to an overhead catch, but can't hang on
another dot ball as Ojha carves the ball straight to cover
punched to the right of the bowler, who moves across quickly to field
batsman looks to sweep fine, came off the back of the bat and looped over the keeper towards short third
on the pads, worked towards midwicket for a comfortable single which gives them nine off the over
dabbed towards point for a single
overpitched from Franklin, batsman capitalises, Ojha carves that past a diving extra cover, Harbhajan Singh also chases from long-off but can't cut off the boundary
angling into legstump, short of length, defended to the off side
shortish, on middle and leg, batsman pulls and gets himself a single
Franklin on now, starts with a short of length ball, well outside off, lashed towards sweeper cover
nearly lobs this back at the bowler, seemed to be a bit early on the shot, a length ball outside off, lands wide of the bowler, only six off the over despite the wide
outside off, drops the ball towards point with soft hands, no time for a single
plays this one towards wide long-on, it was a length ball heading for middle, no power behind the shot and the batsman scramble two
on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg for a single
wide down the leg side
a slower ball bowled from wide of the crease, jabbed towards the off side for a single
Pollard jags that one in, turns that one towards square leg

Tendulkar is on fire here, another direct hit, but there's no run-out this time, Munaf sends a low full toss on the pads, mistimed by the batsman towards deep midwicket, Tendulkar picks up with one arm and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end, batsman was well in though
Munaf responds with a slower ball, 118kmh, eases it to mid-on
a crafty shot that, very nicely done, paddle-swept from well outside off, that goes to fine leg for four
length ball on off, driven towards cover
overpitched outside off, deftly played by Ojha, bends and opens the face of the bat to send the ball towards third man
driven off the front foot towards extra cover
stabs this one towards backward point, there's a direct hit as the batsman look to pinch a quick single, they make their ground though
works this one off the pads towards backward square leg
punched to long-on, think of a second but Franklin is quickly onto the ball
oof, that was nearly out, the batsman was into his stroke early, it nearly lobs to mid-off, then there's plenty of confused running, and a direct hit would have resulted in another wicket
his first delivery beats the batsman, slips between bat and pad as the batsman looks to defend off the back foot
no maiden for Munaf, the final delivery of the over is punched towards long-on for a single
overpitched and outside off, driven firmly towards extra cover, a diving stop means its five dot balls in the over so far
short of length and into middle this time, forward defensive
on offstump this time, defended back to the bowler
back to type from Munaf, short of length and outside off, left alone
full and wide, 137kmh from Munaf, Rao can't get bat on it

and that's the end of Finch, this is turning into a mismatch, a tossed up delivery from Harbhajan, Finch goes for the sweep, top-edges it and Tendulkar is shouting 'catch it, catch it' as Rayudu seems to have misjudged it slightly early on, he moves across to his left from deep backward square leg quickly though to latch on to the ball, Delhi four down now
hit firmly back to the bowler
length ball in middle and leg, punched towards long-on
skates down the track and eases the ball towards cover
on the pads, nudges it towards square leg for a single
defended off the front foot towards the off side
just outside off, poked towards point for a single that helps Ojha keep the strike
well, Sehwag and Warner may be gone, but the big hits haven't, Ojha doesn't bother much with the footwork as he dumps Munaf over long-on for a six
guides this one towards Pollard at backward point
length ball is driven in front of square, can't find the gap
Ojha gets off the mark with a boundary to third man, Munaf bowls his usual short of length and outside off delivery, steered past the keeper and wide of a diving third man
Finch gives no respect to the World Cup winner, looks to smash the first ball over the sightscreen, totally mistimed and it falls near mid-off
mistimes an on-drive, land just short of mid-on

Delhi in dire straits now, a direct hit from Sachin Tendulkar removes Virender Sehwag, Mumbai are ecstatic, Finch played the legstump delivery towards short fine leg and sets off for a single, hesitates midway but Sehwag still wanted the run, Tendulkar fired it in and hit the stumps, Sehwag so far out that the third umpire wasn't needed
fired into the pads, Finch looks to whip that to midwicket, can't get bat on it
Finch finds the boundary this time, gets a long stride in, makes a bit of room and crashes that one in the small gap at point
fullish ball, finch looks to heave it over the leg side, can't beat midwicket
it is a maiden, short of length ball on off, more defence from Sehwag
back of length ball from Malinga, blocked off the back foot by Sehwag, a maiden coming up?
Malinga searches for the yorker again, it ends up as a shin high full toss around offstump, defended by Sehwag
again bat and pad close together as Sehwag gets forward and defends
solidly defended by Sehwag off the front foot, this will be the last over of Malinga in this spell, so Delhi happy to wait out this over
full and straight, Sehwag pushes it to cover
carved towards backward point where Pollard is lurking
a quicker ball, Sehwag skips down the track and pushes the ball back to the bowler
length ball, Sehwag gets forward and launches that over cover for a boundary, it was slightly short from Murtaza
mistimes the ball towards mid-on
eased to long-on for a single
defended towards midwicket
Sehwag isn't all about brutal hitting, he shows his softer side as Malinga sends down a slower ball, dabbed past a diving slip for four
arrowing into Finch's toes, batsman whips it towards deep backward square leg
flings this one down the leg side

Malingaaaaa, Chand's debut hasn't gone well,fast length ball, Chand has no clue to Malinga's bowling, stumps in disarray, as is Delhi's innings, Chand was looking to smash that towards midwicket, that balll hits the middle of middle, what a start from Malinga
Malinga attempts another yorker, this one turns into a full toss, defended by Chand

the famous Malinga yorker makes an early entry, Warner's feet go nowhere, his bails fly a distance after the ball crashes into the stumps, Malinga provides a big early breakthrough, as he does so often, is there anyone with a better yorker in world cricket today?
length ball outside off, outside edge towards third man
muscled towards long-on by Sehwag to end the over, there's a fielder there so it's only a single
Harbhajan resorts to his under-pressure tactic, flat and fired in full, blocked by Sehwag
Sehwag! gets the distance this time, gives himself a bit of room and lofts the ball inside-out over long-off and it clears the ropes

Sehwag nearly continues his tradition of starting with boundaries, this seemed like a massive hit, except it went miles in the air after he came down the track and lofted it towards long-off, didn't have the distance and it lands a few yards within the rope
driven towards mid-off for a single
quiet start, gets forward and pushes towards cover

Tendulkar seals the win, he gets forward and crashes the ball through covers for the boundary to finish off the match with 19 balls to spare, Mumbai were talked up as being one of the favourites for the IPL, they have certainly shown that today with by cantering to victory by eight wickets
full and down the leg side, the wide brings the score level
slower ball again to Rohit, thick inside-edge onto the pads before the ball rolls towards backward point
full and on the leg stump, dug out towards mid-on by Tendulkar

whoah, how slow was that? the speed gun doesn't say anything, it was really short as well, Rohit was shaping for a pull early but had to wait for ages before the ball came onto him, helped towards square leg
short ball, the bouncer is down the leg side
backs away and looks for a swiped towards midwicket, he misses and is struck on the pads, prompting an appeal, umpire's not interested, perhaps because it was sliding down the leg side
defended by Tendulkar towards the bowler
bludgeoned by Tendulkar, comes charging down to get to the pitch and clubs it past the bowler
works this one behind square leg but can't beat the fielder
defended towards the off side by Tendulkar
eased to long-on for a single
watchful defence to end van der Merwe's spell
places this wide of the midwicket to pick up a couple
turned to midwicket, Tendulkar stops after taking a couple of paces, Rohit has to scramble back
carefully defended off the front foot
Shot! Tendulkar hardly hit any sixes last season, he's got his first one in the first match itself this season, an inside-out lofted shot over extra cover
tapped to the right of the bowler
sweeper cover has more work to do, Mumbai pick up a couple
that was nearly bowled, Rohit wanted to send that into the stands, but missed the flat and fast ball, which also missed the stumps
and once more towards sweeper, a lofted shot this time, closer to the fielder
makes room and muscles the ball towards sweeper cover, who has to run across to his right
down the leg side, Tendulkar wanted to play a powerful sweep but can't connect
on the pads, whipped off the backfoot to the leg side for a single
speared into legstump, blocked back to the bowler, don't expect much flight when Finch bowls
three dot balls to end the over, defended towards cover by Rohit
fired into the pads, tucked towards midwicket
defended by Rohit off the back foot
Tendulkar makes room and lashes the ball towards sweeper cover for one more
Rohit stays back and pushes the ball towards cover
Tendulkar shuffles across and nudges the ball towards square leg for a single
lovely shot to end the over, Rohit Sharma gets a big stride in and drives that along the ground past cover for four more, 15 off the over
just outside off, Tendulkar rocks back, makes room and cuts the ball towards point
length ball on offstump, pushed towards cover by Tendulkar
sprays it down the leg side
stands tall and guides the ball towards third man for a single
and another boundary for Rohit, a better shot this, no power just timing as he guides a slightly wide ball past point for four
Rohit decides to change gears, he hammers Morkel's first ball to deep midwicket for four, some sign on aggression from Mumbai batting
full on legstump, eased down to long-on for a single, Mumbai don't seem to be in any hurry here
a bit of air and a bit of width, Tendulkar slaps it towards sweeper cover
blocked off the front foot
fired in full this time, dug out by the batsman to the off side
van der Merwe getting some turn here, it was a short ball so Rohit had time to adjust
Rohit attempts a big hit towards the off side, mistimed towards the on side
Rohit Sharma stands tall and steer the ball towards third man after seeing the width provided
short of length from Morkel, Tendulkar plays with soft hands towards backward point, the ball was dribbling towards the fielder, giving Tendulkar time to take a single
wide outside off, chopped to point by Tendulkar
a lovely flick towards square leg from Rohit Sharma
that one kept lower than Tendulkar expected, especially as it came from the giant Morne Morkel, Tendulkar beaten outside off, keeper can't collect it either
well outside off, Tendulkar glides that one towards backward point, can't beat the fielder
length ball outside off, driven along the ground towards extra cover, too firmly and too close to the fielder to get a run
just outside off, Tendulkar skips away from the stumps to make room and guides the ball to short third
on the pads, worked towards midwicket for a single
hit hard back to the bowler
back foot drive towards cover, another dot ball
jabbed back to the bowler
runs it down to third man for a single
short of length and well outside off, slapped towards deep point for a single
Sachin wants the single after shuffling across and tapping the ball to cover, Rohit was going nowhere, so Tendulkar  turns back
back of length ball played off the front foot from Rohit Sharma, awkwardly played towards cover, zip through for a single
full and outside off, Tendulkar opens the face to guide the ball to third man this time
Tendulkar continues to move across the stump for nearly every ball, this was slanting into him, Tendulkar glances that fine for four, crafty shot that
pushed off the back foot to cover to end the over
Tendulkar eases the ball towards cover to pick up an easy single
massive appeal for lbw, Irfan is convinced, Hawk-Eye says that pitched on legstump and was going on to hit legstump, Irfan is can't believe that was turned down, Rohit survives
Rohit drives his first ball off the front foot towards point
on the middle stump, tucked towards midwicket

outstanding work from van der Merwe, that breaks the partnership, Rayudu leans across to drive a ball angling across him to extra cover, van der Merwe moves across from mid-off, he's on all fours as he fields, still manages to turn around and effects a direct hit that catches Rayudu short, that was amazing fielding
a high full toss to end the over, nearly waist high, Tendulkar doesn't at all seem surprised by it, taps the ball towards mid-on after moving across the stumps
a full ball on middle, pushed towards midwicket, where some lazy fielding allows two
on off stump, and once more the batsman shuffles across and tucks the ball to square leg

what a shot that is from Rayudu, short ball from Umesh, Rayudu moves across and pulls powerfully, and has that gone all the way?, hits the boundary rope on the full, I thought it did at least, but after several replays, the umpires think it landed just short of the rope and Rayudu gets four
full delivery, edged onto the pads by Tendulkar, ball dribbles to square leg
strikes the pads with his first delivery, that was sliding down though
guides the ball to backward point for a single to end the over
an ugly shot from Rayud, pitched up by Irfan, and a flat-batted mistimed hit from Rayudu sends the ball back to the bowler
hello! that straightened off the pitch and opened up Rayudu, keeper is absolutely convinced there was an edge, Irfan doesn't bother to appeal, except after he sees Ojha pleading with umpire

Tendulkar attempts a suicidal single, he punched the ball straight to Dinda at mid-on, Dinda was off-balance as he threw at the stumps, nowhere near the stumps, Tendulkar nowhere near making his ground
that one keeps really low, the famous Tendulkar crouch on display as he keeps that one out
not a great start, wide down the leg side
dropped, a very tough chance for Sehwag, he leapt to his right earlier in the over, this time he has to fly to his left after Tendulkar is squared up, Sehwag gets a hand on it but can't hold on
speared down the leg side, not too far outside the legstump, but it's still a wide, Tendulkar was moving across the stumps and looking to whip it away, no bat on it
Tendulkar also wanted to get a single to third man, Sehwag leaps from wide slip to cut that off and Tendulkar has to scramble back after setting off for a single
a bit of width on offer, Rayudu guides the ball to third man sensibly
short and outside off, carved towards cover by Tendulkar
length ball on off and middle, driven towards mid-on, not too well timed
Tendulkar drives on the up and gets it away towards sweeper cover for a couple, he changed the bat after the previous over
the first boundary for Mumbai, short of length and outside off, back foot cover drive from Rayudu, bisects the fielders in the circle and that races for four
another bouncer from Dinda, well outside off, Rayudu mistimes an attempt to guide the ball to point
length ball on middle stump, Tendulkar jumps across the stumps and tucks the ball in front of square leg
pitches it up this time, on the pads, and nudged towards square leg
147kmh, hard to believe that speed gun, Dinda delivers the first bouncer of the match (I think), batsman ducks under
a muted appeal for lbw, but that was going down leg and perhaps height was a concern as well, off Tendulkar's pad towards square leg
Tendulkar hasn't looked at ease today, this ball surprises him with the bounce, more than he expects and the bottom had comes off as he defends outside off
short of length on middle stump, nicely played by Rayudu, who moves across the stumps and tucks the ball towards square leg
just short of a length and outside off, Tendulkar gets forward to drive, gets a thick outside edge past slip and down to third man for a single
length ball outside off, Rayudu waits and opens the face to steer the ball to third man
way down the leg side

Morkel strikes, Jacobs is gone, back of a length ball that nipped sharply back, Jacobs' feet go nowhere as he looks to chop that through the off side, it sneaks past his bat and on to off stump, his debut innings isn't one to remember, and Delhi send the message that they aren't going to just roll over though they have only 95 on board
length ball on the off from Morne to start, solidly blocked by Jacobs
good over to start from Dinda, getting some movement here, Tendulkar tries to scythe the ball through cover off the front foot, but the ball bounces too much for him and he is beaten
the screaming reaches a crescendo as Dinda charges in to Tendulkar, looks to tuck that one to fine leg but is struck on the pads
Mumbai and Jacobs get off the mark as Jacobs pushes the ball towards cover and sneaks a single, huge cheer from the crowd, not for Jacobs' first run I can reliably inform you
Jacobs looks for another forward defensive, gets an inside-edge towards the leg side
swing for Dinda, who still has that giant leap before delivery, length ball is blocked off the front foot
Jacobs defends the first ball off the front foot towards mid-on
